short_description: Melanoma is a serious type of skin cancer that can develop from moles or appear as a new dark spot. Early detection is very important.
common_symptoms: change in size of a mole
temporary_advice: Monitor any mole or spot carefully
avoid: Do not ignore changes in moles
Do not try to remove it yourself
risk_notes: Melanoma is a serious condition that requires early medical evaluation. Early detection can greatly improve outcomes.
when_to_see_doctor: Immediately if a mole changes in size, shape, or color
If a mole bleeds or itches
If a new unusual dark spot appears
If there are multiple colors in a lesion
If you are unsure about any skin change
